info.title: Chat Service API
info.description: Chat Service HTTP API checked against the current NestJS controllers, DTO validation, Prisma schema, and service implementation. Socket.IO handshake behavior is summarized here, but application events require AsyncAPI once defined.
x-documentation-notes: Message history currently returns a raw newest-first array containing up to limit + 1 rows; the lookahead row and cursor envelope are not finalized.
Message edits require the original author and reject soft-deleted messages.
Group management is implemented with authenticated, active-user guarded routes. Group creation creates the creator as ADMIN and a general channel in the same nested database write.
Group invitations are deferred; admins add existing active users directly. The last group admin cannot be demoted or removed.

Message sends are authorized for DM participants or current group members in channel conversations; new messages are emitted to their private user rooms. Group channels are not included in the DM conversation list; channel unread state is available from the group channel list.

post.summary: Create or get a direct conversation
post.description: Creates one canonical DM for the authenticated user and target user, or returns the existing DM. Participant UUIDs are sorted before lookup. Missing local ChatUser profiles are lazily bootstrapped from User service; either user must exist there and must not be locally deleted. Self-DM currently reaches the generic 500 error handler.

201.description: Existing or newly created direct conversation

503.description: User service could not bootstrap a missing profile

get.description: Returns conversations where the authenticated user is one of the two DM participants. Each item includes the caller's nullable last-read message ID and a derived unread count. Unread messages are non-deleted messages authored by another user after the marker in (createdAt, id) order; without a marker, all such messages are unread. The response does not include group channels, participant profiles, latest-message summaries, or a guaranteed sort order. Each DM includes public profile summaries for both participants.

200.description: Direct conversations visible to the caller

post.description: Persists a message for an authenticated DM participant or a current member of the group that owns a CHANNEL conversation. The server emits a newly stored message to the DM participants or current group members through their private user rooms. clientRequestId scopes idempotency to the author. A same-ID request with a different conversation/content hash returns 409; an identical retry returns the existing message and does not emit again.

201.description: New message or the stored message returned for an identical retry

get.description: Returns a raw newest-first message array. The current implementation queries limit + 1 rows for lookahead but does not remove the extra row or return hasMore/nextBefore. The optional before value is a unique Message.id cursor and the cursor row is skipped.

200.description: Messages ordered by createdAt descending, then id descending

patch.description: Validates that messageId belongs to the supplied conversation and that the caller is a DM participant or a current member of the owning group, then upserts ConversationReadState by (conversationId, userId). The current implementation permits the marker to move backward.

200.description: Read marker saved; current response has no JSON body

patch.description: Only the original author can edit a non-deleted message. The update replaces content, sets editedAt, and atomically increments version. Missing, deleted, and other users' messages all return 404.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a message owned by the authenticated user. Chat clears content, sets deletedAt, and atomically increments version. Missing, already deleted, and other users' messages all return 404.

get.description: Returns groups where the authenticated active user is a member, including the caller's role and channel summaries.

post.description: Creates a group, makes the caller an ADMIN, and creates its general text channel in one database operation.

201.description: Group created with its general channel

patch.description: Only group admins can update the name, description, or rules. Omitted fields are unchanged; explicit null clears description or rules.

delete.description: Only a group admin can delete the group. Related channels and messages are removed by database cascades.

get.description: Requires group membership. Member results contain only public profile fields.

post.description: Only group admins can add an existing active User-service account. New members receive MEMBER role. Invitations are not implemented.

delete.description: Removes the authenticated user from the group. The last admin cannot leave until another member is promoted or the group is deleted.
Only group admins can remove another member. Removing the last admin is rejected.

patch.description: Only group admins can set a member role to ADMIN or MEMBER. The last admin cannot be demoted.

get.description: Requires group membership. Each channel includes the caller's lastReadMessageId and the count of non-deleted messages from other members after that marker.

post.description: Only group admins can create text channels.

get.description: Requires group membership; the channel must belong to the specified group.

patch.description: Only group admins can update channel name or topic. Omitted fields are unchanged; explicit null clears topic.

delete.description: Only group admins can delete a channel. Related messages are removed by database cascades.

get.description: Returns the feed group and channel IDs, and joins the caller to the feed if needed. Posts use the normal message endpoints with this channel ID.
Newest-first, non-deleted posts by this author in the feed channel. Returns up to limit + 1 rows, where the extra row signals more results. Joins the caller to the feed so attachment URLs work.

post.description: Returns a five-minute POST policy for a server-generated object key. The browser sends the returned fields and the file directly to MinIO as multipart/form-data.

get.description: Returns a five-minute presigned GET URL for images and videos. Other types return a null previewUrl.

parameters.name: objectKey
parameters.description: Key of an attachment on a non-deleted message in this conversation.

get.description: Returns a five-minute presigned GET URL with attachment disposition.

parameters.description: Key of an attachment on a non-deleted message in this conversation.

MessageLimit.name: limit

BeforeMessageId.name: before
BeforeMessageId.description: Message UUID used as a Prisma cursor; that message is skipped.

content.description: Text content; leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed before validation

clientRequestId.description: Client-generated idempotency identifier for one logical send

messageId.description: Latest message the client reports as read

content.description: Replacement text; leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed before validation

lastReadMessageId.description: The caller's current read marker, or null before any message is marked read

unreadCount.description: Non-deleted messages from other users after the caller's read marker

attachments.description: MinIO object keys. Never signed URLs.

maxBytes.description: 10 MiB, or 50 MiB for video types.

previewUrl.description: Null for types that cannot be shown inline, such as PDF.

x-socket-io.serverBehavior: After authentication the socket joins user:<sub>. A newly committed DM message is emitted to both DM participants, and a newly committed group-channel message is emitted to the current group members, using their private user rooms. An idempotent HTTP retry does not emit again.
